description: BOA\* finds one path for every Pareto-optimal cost vector from a start to a goal when each edge has two costs. A path is *Pareto-optimal* when no other path is at least as good in both costs and better in one. BOA\* expands paths in lexicographic order of `f = g + h`: first by `f1`, then by `f2`. With a *consistent* heuristic (one that never drops by more than an edge's cost along that edge), BOA\* drops a path when its `g2` or its `f2` cannot improve on the paths it already expanded; each test takes constant time. Use it for exact two-objective routing; with a zero heuristic it is a bi-objective Dijkstra search.
